title: StepTrigger: Contact-State-Triggered Backdoor Attacks on VLM-Powered Legged Robots
abstract: arXiv:2609.26131v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models and vision-language models are increasingly used as high-level planners in robotic systems, using task goals and sensor summaries to select navigation or manipulation actions. This creates a new backdoor surface: a compromised planner can behave normally in most runs, yet change its target selection when a hidden trigger is present. Prior attacks on LLM-powered or embodied agents mainly rely on triggers that appear in language, camera-visible objects, scene semantics, or specific sequences of past actions. This paper presents StepTrigger, a contact-state-triggered backdoor attack for VLM-powered legged robots. The trigger is not a prompt token or a visible marker. It is produced by pressure and foot-ground contact patterns that arise when a Unitree Go1 quadruped walks across a dense terrain patch. translated_title: StepTrigger：针对视觉语言模型驱动的足式机器人的接触状态触发后门攻击
translated_abstract: 大语言模型和视觉语言模型越来越多地被用作机器人系统中的高层规划器，利用任务目标和传感器摘要来选择导航或操作动作。这创造了一个新的后门攻击面：被攻陷的规划器在大多数运行中表现正常，但在存在隐藏触发器时会改变其目标选择。以往针对LLM驱动的或具身智能体的攻击主要依赖于出现在语言中、摄像头可见物体中、场景语义中或过去动作特定序列中的触发器。本文提出了StepTrigger，一种针对视觉语言模型驱动的足式机器人的接触状态触发后门攻击。该触发器不是提示词标记或可见标记，而是由Unitree Go1四足机器人走过密集地形区域时产生的压力和足-地接触模式所形成的。与传统视觉或文本触发器不同，接触信号本质上带有噪声，并且也可能在其他情况下自然出现。
tldr: 本文提出StepTrigger后门攻击，利用四足机器人在特定密集地形上行走时产生的足-地接触状态模式作为隐蔽触发器，无需提示词或可见标记即可操控视觉语言模型驱动的规划器改变目标选择。
en_tdlr: This paper presents StepTrigger, a backdoor attack that uses foot-ground contact-state patterns arising when a quadruped robot walks over a dense terrain patch as a hidden trigger, enabling manipulation of VLM-powered planners without prompt tokens or visible markers.
